mintAuthority.summary: TRYB is issued by BiLira using a FiatTokenProxy pattern on Ethereum. The ETH owner is a Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (3 signers, 2-of-3, no modules); the masterMinter controlling minting allowances is a separate Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 (6 signers, 3-of-6, no modules). No proxy admin (admin slot=0). Both on-chain controls confirmed.

controls.label: BiLira issuance backend
controls.evidence: BiLira operates the centralized 1:1 mint/redeem for TRYB against TRY cash reserves and manages native deployments across chains; no permissionless or user-collateralized mint route exists.

controls.label: TRYB ETH owner Safe (2-of-3)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294993: owner() on FiatTokenProxy 0x2c537e5624e4af88a7ae4060c022609376c8d0eb returned 0xb9fda3c5a457573535684f591f3e00d949a8dad6. getOwners() confirmed 3 owners; getThreshold() = 2; slot 0 = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Gnosis Safe 1.3.0 singleton). getModulesPaginated returned empty (next=0x1, arr_len=0). EIP-1967 impl and admin slots both 0x0 (not a proxy in the ERC1967 sense; FiatTokenProxy stores impl in custom slot).

controls.label: TRYB ETH masterMinter Safe (3-of-6)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294993: masterMinter() on FiatTokenProxy 0x2c537e5624e4af88a7ae4060c022609376c8d0eb returned 0x68193b59a8b188f04da07fa234888b1926384b8e. getOwners() confirmed 6 owners; getThreshold() = 3; slot 0 = 0xd9db270c1b5e3bd161e8c8503c55ceabee709552 (Gnosis Safe 1.3.0). getModulesPaginated returned empty.

controls.label: TRYB legacy proxy upgrade admin (2-of-3 multisig)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25580032, the FiatTokenProxy legacy admin slot resolves to 0xfa161fce6c543647cb5ce86d1ee7fa303eb951c4. Its verified MultiSigWalletWithDailyLimit contract reports required() = 2 and getOwners() = three addresses. The proxy implementation slot resolves to FiatTokenV2 at 0x5f88d1a517b670a14ded5d0cf8b3d37e554d977b.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294993: TRYB ETH is a FiatTokenProxy (0x2c537e5624e4af88a7ae4060c022609376c8d0eb, source verified as FiatTokenProxy on Blockscout). owner() = Safe 0xb9fda3c... Both confirmed via getOwners(), getThreshold(), slot 0 masterCopy, and getModulesPaginated. EIP-1967 impl and admin slots are 0x0 (FiatTokenProxy uses custom storage). BSC chain: owner and masterMinter share a single EOA address (0x07913270..., confirmed code=0 on BSC). Ethereum mint surface fully resolved. Corpus Denetim ve Yeminli Mali Musavirlik A.S. performs recurring quarterly independent examinations; the latest reviewed report is dated May 21, 2026 and fully reconciles TRYB liabilities to reserve assets. Turkey's Capital Markets Board temporary operating list matches the BiLira platform but expressly says inclusion is not authorization, and BiLira was not matched in the Central Bank's authorized EMI register. Supervision is therefore attestation-only.
